mcqs.question: Which organisations collaborated on the large-format 3D-printing initiative reported in August 2026?
options: Samtel HAL Display Systems and HAL
mcqs.explanation: Lohia Aerospace Systems collaborated with Massivit of Israel on the large-format 3D-printing initiative. L&T-NxT and Vyoma were associated with the single-cluster AI facility, while QpiAI and C-DAC were associated with quantum processors and the ‘Vihaan’ SoC respectively.

mcqs.question: Which statement correctly describes India’s participation in Exercise Talisman Sabre 2027?
options: India is to join the Australia–USA co-hosted exercise in Australia
India is to join the India–Malaysia exercise at Subang Air Base
India is to join the India–Thailand exercise at Vibhavadi Rangsit Camp
India is to join the India–Vietnam coast guard exercise at Chennai
mcqs.explanation: India is to join Talisman Sabre 2027, which is co-hosted by Australia and the USA and is scheduled in Australia from 9–22 August 2027. Subang Air Base is associated with Udara Shakti 2026, Vibhavadi Rangsit Camp with Maitree-XV, and Chennai with Sahyog Hop Tac.
